description: This file implements the EnvVariableParser class, which manages environment variable-based configuration for logging levels, console logging, and file logging in the Rialto project. It includes functions to parse environment variables, determine logging levels, and initialize logging settings based on environment variables.

classes.name: EnvVariableParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing environment variables to configure logging levels, console logging, and file logging for the Rialto project.

methods.name: EnvVariableParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes debug levels, and configures debug, console, and file logging based on environment variables.

methods.name: configureRialtoDebug
methods.description: Configures debug levels for different components based on the RIALTO_DEBUG environment variable.

methods.name: configureRialtoConsoleLog
methods.description: Enables console logging if the RIALTO_CONSOLE_LOG environment variable is set to '1'.

methods.name: configureFileLogging
methods.description: Initializes file logging if enabled, using the log file path from environment variables.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the debug level for a specified component.

methods.name: isConsoleLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether console logging is enabled.

methods.name: isFileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether file logging is enabled.
